Penalty for unexpected elements in a formula

dot-element_penalty.Rd

Penalty for unexpected elements in a formula

Usage

.element_penalty(
  formula,
  penalties,
  allowed,
  default = 100,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

formula

Character vector of formulas; NA gives no penalty.

penalties

Named numeric vector: penalty per atom of an element.

allowed

Character vector of elements that may occur unpenalised.

default

Penalty per atom of an element that is neither in penalties nor in allowed.

call

Call environment for errors.

Value

Numeric vector. Each atom of an element in penalties adds that element's penalty; each atom of an element in neither penalties nor allowed adds default. Aborts on an unrecognised element symbol.
